_about: CM-061 part 3 (rewrite 3 §5): every finding of the one checker pass per step has one severity. scripts/review.py enforces it: a 'fix' must be a form category; an 'ask' must be one of the four kinds (a kind-3 Ask links a valid research-log entry; a kind-4 Ask names two sources); anything else with a recommended option becomes 'fix_and_list'. Definitions: methodology/definitions.md.

fix._about: Form only — fixed silently, logged in the run only, never in the review sheet.

fix_and_list._about: A content change made by default with the recommended option, listed under 'Decided for you' in the review sheet. Anyone can override it.

ask._about: Only these four kinds reach Paul as a question, each with options and a recommended default.

kinds.1: page or URL decision — create, merge, drop, redirect
kinds.2: legal or money claim about the client — warranties, prices, financing, licences, insurance, permits the client says it pulls, guarantees
kinds.3: client-only fact not found after the search order (research.py log, kind client) — batched into one client question list per section, with pre-filled best answers
kinds.4: real conflict — two sources of equal standing that disagree
